items.title: Running SnapLogic Jean-Paul in Production on Amazon Bedrock
items.summary: Enterprises can build an AI agent that reasons impressively in a pilot, but moving it into production is where projects stall. The blocker is rarely the model, it is the infrastructure, security, and governance. This post shows how SnapLogic's Jean-Paul runs inside your own AWS account on Amazon Bedrock, the production-readiness pattern for taking an enterprise AI agent from pilot to production on AWS.
items.creator: Tamara Astakhova
